description.value: Bold Italian Eatery is a sit-down Italian restaurant inside Kamloops' Sahali Centre Mall, serving housemade pasta, piadina sandwiches, and polenta fries alongside a bar program featuring local craft breweries and wineries. The kitchen partners with a roster of Kamloops-area producers including Iron Road Brewery, Monte Creek Winery, and Frozen Paddle Craft Ice Cream. Cyclists passing through Kamloops will find a full-service meal stop with a varied menu spanning light lunch fare through hearty pasta dishes.

address.value: 196 - 945 Columbia Street West, Sahali Centre Mall, Kamloops, BC V2C 1M4
